content.short: Virtua Broker provides multi-currency accounts and fast international payments, including in USDC.
content.description: Virtua Broker lets businesses send and receive international payments in seconds, managing multi-currency accounts, including IBANs and USDC, from one dashboard. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Virtua Broker.
